sql_reading_A.note: "subjects in the Mathematics department" = subject department itself
sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH math_subjects AS (
    SELECT
        c.SUBJECT_CODE,
        c.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        c.TOTAL_UNITS,
        c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
        o.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
        ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
       AND s.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED o
        ON o.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
       AND o.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
      AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    TOTAL_UNITS,
    IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
        ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE
    ) AS ROW_NUM
FROM math_subjects;
